query:
UPDATE items
                            SET name              = COALESCE($1, name),
                                description       = COALESCE($2, description),
                                base_price_cents  = COALESCE($3, base_price_cents),
                                image_url         = COALESCE($4, image_url),
                                active            = COALESCE($5, active),
                                updated_at        = NOW(),
                                updated_by        = COALESCE($7, updated_by)
                            WHERE id = $6
